description: This file defines the main application class for the Coocook web application, including configuration, plugin setup, and application initialization. It uses Moose and Catalyst, and sets up various plugins, configuration options, and helper methods.

classes.name: Coocook
classes.description: Main application class for the Coocook web app, extending Catalyst, configuring plugins, and setting application-wide settings.

methods.name: mod_installed
methods.description: Checks if a Perl module is installed by attempting to require it and returning the module name if successful.

methods.name: setup_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes application setup, including setting email sender name and content security policy.
